title: Experimental and theoretical insights into two tri- and tetranuclear DyIII SMMs reveal the unusual superiority of triangular dodecahedral DyIII over square antiprismatic DyIII as an SIM centre

material_class.structural_family: trinuclear Dy3 cluster with tris(μ-phenoxido) terminal–central–terminal core

synthesis.procedure: A methanol solution (2 mL) of Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (0.088 g, 0.2 mmol) was added dropwise to a stirred suspension of H2L (0.052 g, 0.2 mmol) in methanol (3 mL). After stirring for 10 minutes, a methanol solution (2 mL) of triethylamine (0.02 g, 0.2 mmol) was added dropwise. The resulting yellow solution was stirred for 10 minutes, filtered into a long tube, and diethyl ether was added slowly to form two layers. The tube was sealed air-tight and left undisturbed. After a few days, orange diffraction-quality crystals deposited, were collected by filtration and washed with cold methanol.
synthesis.time: stirred 10 min after metal/ligand mixing, then 10 min after Et3N addition; crystals after a few days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: layered crystallization in a sealed long tube (methanol filtrate under diethyl ether)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered to remove suspended particles; diethyl ether layered on the methanol filtrate; orange crystals collected by filtration and washed with cold methanol

properties.summary: Field-induced SMM (1000 Oe DC); no slow relaxation under zero DC field. Room-temperature χMT = 40.49 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 42.50 for three DyIII); decreases to 24.28 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with anisotropy, Stark depopulation and weak antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization 15.43 NμB at 7 T and 2 K. Two AC relaxation channels. Best Orbach+Raman+QTM fit: Ueff = 32.3 cm−1, τ0 = 2.25×10−9 s, τQTM = 1.63×10−3 s.

material_class.structural_family: butterfly-type Dy4 cluster (two body Dy_b and two wing Dy_w)

synthesis.procedure: A DMF solution (2 mL) of Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (0.088 g, 0.2 mmol) was added dropwise to a DMF (3 mL) solution of H2L (0.052 g, 0.2 mmol) and the mixture was heated. After heating for 10 minutes, a DMF solution (2 mL) of triethylamine (0.02 g, 0.2 mmol) was added dropwise under heating. The orange solution was heated for a further 10 minutes, cooled, filtered into a long tube, and diethyl ether was layered slowly. The tube was sealed air-tight and left undisturbed. After a few days, orange diffraction-quality crystals deposited and were collected by filtration.
synthesis.time: heated 10 min after metal/ligand mixing, then 10 min after Et3N; crystals after a few days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: heated DMF reaction followed by layered crystallization in a sealed long tube (DMF filtrate under diethyl ether)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled, filtered to remove suspended particles; diethyl ether layered on the filtrate; orange crystals collected by filtration

properties.summary: Zero-field SMM with two relaxation channels assigned to the two DyIII site types. Room-temperature χMT = 53.87 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 56.68 for four DyIII); decreases to 28.78 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization 21.05 NμB at 7 T and 2 K. Experimental Orbach+Raman Ueff = 44.53 cm−1; including QTM gives Ueff = 45.77 cm−1. Abstract also quotes a simulated Ueff of 65.1 cm−1.
